title: Fix category display to show all categories in responsive grid

requirements.text: Modify the category filter bar to display all categories in a responsive grid layout that wraps to multiple rows, ensuring all 22-23 categories are visible on screen simultaneously without horizontal overflow

quotes: I have about 22, 23 of them and there's only showing like 11
I want to see all the categories on the screen at the same time
if you want to do left to right and then bring them down once they hit the end of the screen

acceptanceCriteria: All categories (22-23) are visible on screen without requiring horizontal scroll
Categories wrap to new rows when they reach the edge of the screen
Layout remains responsive across different screen sizes
No categories are hidden off-screen to the right

requirements.text: Ensure the category grid appears directly below the search bar, with Favorites and Create Category buttons positioned at the start of the category list, followed by all user-created categories

quotes: they are right below the search bar. Starting from left to right, There is 'Favorites' then 'Create Category', and then the categories beginn

acceptanceCriteria: Category section appears immediately below the search bar
Favorites button appears first in the layout
All user categories follow after these two buttons
All items maintain consistent visual spacing and alignment

constraints: Do not change the backend schema or data structure
Maintain existing category selection, creation, and deletion functionality
Preserve current search and filtering behavior
nonGoals: Changing the overall app layout or navigation structure
Modifying how categories are created or managed
Altering search functionality or prompt display modes
